assertions.description: An actual SpeechRecognitionResult exposes the proposed readonly audioStartTime attribute on the result receiver.
assertions.test: Not run automatically: SpeechRecognitionResult has LegacyNoInterfaceObject, cannot be constructed, and obtaining a result requires an implementing recognition backend plus user-mediated microphone permission.

assertions.description: An actual SpeechRecognitionResult exposes the proposed readonly audioEndTime attribute on the result receiver.
assertions.test: Not run automatically: a live result requires an implementing recognition backend and an explicit user-mediated microphone session.

assertions.description: result.audioStartTime is either a DOMHighResTimeStamp number in milliseconds relative to the time origin or null when the backend supplies no segment timing.
assertions.test: Not run automatically: the value exists only on a live result object; no timestamp may be fabricated or inferred from event cadence.

assertions.description: result.audioEndTime is either a DOMHighResTimeStamp number in milliseconds relative to the time origin or null when the backend supplies no segment timing.
assertions.test: Not run automatically: the value exists only on a live result object; no timestamp may be fabricated or inferred from event cadence.

assertions.description: When both timing values are numbers for a transcribed audio segment, audioStartTime is no later than audioEndTime.
assertions.test: Not run automatically: ordered segment bounds require values from the same live SpeechRecognitionResult.

assertions.description: For a live result with numeric audioEndTime, event.timeStamp − result.audioEndTime is a finite processing-latency value because both operands use the time-origin clock.
assertions.test: Not run automatically: this contract requires the actual result event and its actual result object; synthetic sample lag is not conformance evidence.

assertions.description: audioStartTime and audioEndTime are readonly attributes; script assignment does not replace the values supplied by the recognition implementation.
assertions.test: Not run automatically: readonly behavior must be checked on an actual live SpeechRecognitionResult receiver.

assertions.description: audioStartTime and audioEndTime belong to SpeechRecognitionResult, not to each SpeechRecognitionAlternative or to SpeechRecognitionEvent.
assertions.test: Not run automatically: receiver placement must be verified on an actual live result, its alternative, and the containing event without inventing interface objects.
